categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and title classifications. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
